saw_lines: Wealthy families rarely buy from a banner. They choose an adviser after one long talk, then stay for decades.
So the sale is won in the first line of each ad, where trust either forms or the prospect scrolls past.
Your 34 Google creatives split 15 text, 15 image and 4 video, so lead the next batch with a client quote from your site on every text ad.
ads_1: Client quote text ads, then adviser video on Gradual Security
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook, Instagram and Youtube
